definitions.explanation: Rectangular pieces of pounded rice cake, typically sold in individually wrapped blocks. A staple food especially around New Year.

examples.japanese: {切り餅|きりもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
{切り餅|きりもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made ozoni with two pieces of block mochi.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{切り餅|きりもち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: When New Year approaches, lots of block mochi are displayed at the supermarket.

notes:
Refers to mochi that has been pounded and cut into uniform rectangular blocks, as opposed to {丸餅|まるもち} (round mochi). {切り餅|きりもち} is the dominant form in eastern Japan, while {丸餅|まるもち} is traditional in western Japan. Commercially packaged {切り餅|きりもち} is a pantry staple that can be stored for months.

- {切り餅|きりもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to boil mochi
- {個包装|こほうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切り餅|きりもち}: individually wrapped block mochi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丸餅|まるもち}: round mochi — the round form traditional in western Japan
- ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧: rice cake — the general term for pounded rice cake in any shape
- ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧: mirror mochi — a decorative stacked mochi offering for New Year
